nodes.title: National Disability Insurance Scheme Act 2013 (Cth)
nodes.note: Principal Act; amended by Integrity and Safeguarding Act 2026

nodes.title: National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Act 2026
nodes.note: Passed 1 Apr 2026; Royal Assent 8 Apr 2026. Sch 1 (Commission powers) and Sch 3 (whistleblower) commenced 9 Apr 2026; Sch 2 (NDIA operational incl. electronic claims) 6 May 2026. Provider effects: serious-contravention civil penalties; offence to provide registration-required supports while unregistered; expanded banning orders incl. auditors and advisors; anti-promotion orders; stronger whistleblower protections

nodes.title: NDIS (Provider Registration and Practice Standards) Rules 2018
nodes.note: FRL series F2018L00631. Practice Standards housed in Schedules 1-8 (Core = Sch 1; HIDPA = Sch 2; M2 = Sch 3; M2A = Sch 4; M3 = Sch 5; M4 = Sch 6; M5 SDA = Sch 7; Verification 'Module 6' = Sch 8). Body: s 7 registration classes, s 13B mid-term audit, s 20 applicable standards, s 24 QI Guidelines link. Latest published compilation C04 = F2021C01137 (15 Nov 2021) as at 5 Jul 2026 - the 2026 SIL amendments are made but not yet consolidated at this URL

nodes.title: NDIS (Provider Registration and Practice Standards) Amendment (Mandatory Registration and Other Matters) Rules 2026
nodes.note: Mandatory SIL & platform provider registration + SIL Practice Standards, from 1 Jul 2026

nodes.title: NDIS (Quality Indicators for NDIS Practice Standards) Guidelines 2018
nodes.note: F2018N00041; made under s 181D(2) of the Act; registered 18 May 2018, commenced 1 Jul 2018. Renamed from (Quality Indicators) Guidelines 2018. Current compilation C03 = F2026C00528, in force 1 Jul 2026 - includes the Module 5A (SIL) indicators at ss 72B-72E

nodes.title: NDIS (Approved Quality Auditors Scheme) Guidelines 2018
nodes.note: F2018N00114. Governs certification and verification audits; audit reports due to Commission 14 days (verification) / 28 days (certification, mid-term) after completion. New AQA approvals suspended pending 2025-26 reforms; see also AQAR25

nodes.title: NDIS (Approved Quality Auditors) Rules 2025
nodes.note: F2025L01383, listed on the Commission legislation page (May 2026); relationship to the 2018 AQA Scheme Guidelines to be confirmed

nodes.note: SIL quality indicators; consolidated into the principal Guidelines at compilation C03 (1 Jul 2026)
